description: This script facilitates ingestion of JSON data files into a SQLite database for seeding or updating the database with roles, competencies, and resources related to a career path navigation application. It includes functions for loading JSON files safely, establishing a database connection, and inserting data into respective tables, all with precautions for duplication and errors. The main function orchestrates the process by locating data files in a predefined directory and invoking specific ingestion functions.

methods.name: Any _safe_load_json(path: str)
methods.description: Safely loads JSON data from a given file path, returning None if the file does not exist or an error occurs.

methods.name: sqlite3.Connection _ensure_conn()
methods.description: Creates and configures a SQLite database connection with foreign key support enabled.

methods.name: None ingest_roles(roles_json: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]], conn: sqlite3.Connection)
methods.description: Inserts role data into the 'roles' table, ignoring duplicates.

methods.name: None ingest_competencies(defs_json: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]], conn: sqlite3.Connection)
methods.description: Inserts competency data into the 'competencies' table, ignoring duplicates.

methods.name: None ingest_resources(resources_json: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]], conn: sqlite3.Connection)
methods.description: Inserts resource data into the 'resources' table, avoiding duplicates based on title and URL.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main execution function that determines data directory, loads JSON files, and processes data ingestion.

ctags.name: ingest_competencies
ctags.pattern: /^def ingest_competencies(defs_json: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]], conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:$/

ctags.name: ingest_resources
ctags.pattern: /^def ingest_resources(resources_json: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]], conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None/

ctags.name: ingest_roles
ctags.pattern: /^def ingest_roles(roles_json: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]], conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:$/
